title: Saying I Am Calm Fuels Panic, Yet Coaching By Your First Name Quiets It
description:
You think repeating I am calm stops stage fright fast! Yet coaching yourself by your first name works far better! This is the true story of the Michigan silent speech study. Here is what went wrong with old pep talk advice.
